svg.title: Which path fits your assistant?
svg.desc: Which path fits your assistant?. Agent Direct: Codex CLI, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot cloud agent. File Transfer: Browser chat. Copy and Paste: Browser chat. GUI: Kit interface. The four paths are not equally mature.

svg.text: Choose an available interface for your tool and task
The four paths are not equally mature.
